name: Kings Origin
detailed_description:
Lead your army, customize your rooms, and challenge your enemies in a detailed dungeon inspired by classic board games.

Prepare for battle — a horde of enemies is about to storm your domain!

Build your dungeon, recruit adventurers, choose your path, and protect your realm from those who dare to overthrow you.

--><--

◆ Choose Your Lord!

  • Lords are the heart of Kings Origin: a vibrant cast of over 6 unique characters, each with their own personality, background, and motivations.

  • Decide your allegiance and playstyle: will you go for direct combat with a powerful lord, build a deadly maze full of traps, or empower your minions to defend your kingdom? Every strategy is viable.

  • Follow the tale of a young and inexperienced queen as she faces the growing threat of the mortal realm.

--><--

◆ Create Your Own Adventure!

  • Shape your playthrough with custom strategies, dungeon layouts, and branching paths.

  • The possibilities are endless: forge dark pacts through special events, uncover unique relics, face unexpected twists, ambushes, and secrets hidden in the shadows.

  • Think carefully when placing traps, rooms, and minions. A well-built strategy will help you survive endless waves and unlock even more content for your dungeon.

  • Each day, choose your fate from a set of destiny cards. Want to fight? Enemies will come. Craving surprises? Special events await. The choice is yours as master of the dungeon.

  • And don’t forget to share your creations online and climb the global rankings of Dungeon Lords!

--><--

◆ CONTENT

  • Lords with unique abilities

  • Units, heroes, and mythical beasts

  • Traps and rooms to build your dungeon

  • Mysterious relics with arcane powers

  • Dynamic events full of surprises

  • Tons of unlockable elements throughout your journey

Rule as a true monarch: expand your domain room by room, build an unbreakable defense, and lead your dungeon to glory.

short_description: Kings Origin is a strategic roguelike dungeon builder in the purest board game spirit. Defend your domain by simulating a tactical board game match with specialized units and rooms while enduring relentless waves of enemies. Do you have what it takes to reign as a true Dungeon Lord?

  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 10 capable GPU
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
